content.text:
Issue 1220 analysis

Type: Bug.

What I read
- GitHub issue 1220, no comments or linked PRs.
- Code file in full: packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-manager.ts.

Root cause
- DefaultPackageManager.runCommand and runCommandSync call spawn or spawnSync with the command string directly.
- On Windows, npm is resolved via npm.cmd. spawn does not resolve npm to npm.cmd in this usage, so npm invocations fail with ENOENT.
- This affects install, uninstall, update, and getGlobalNpmRoot since all of them call runCommand or runCommandSync with "npm".

Proposed fix
- Add a small command resolver that maps "npm" to "npm.cmd" on win32.
- Use that resolver in runCommand and runCommandSync before calling spawn or spawnSync.
- Keep git untouched.

Affected files
- packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-manager.ts
  - Add a helper like resolveCommand(command: string): string.
  - Update runCommand and runCommandSync to call it.
  - Optionally extend mapping to other package managers only if they are used later.

No implementation done.
